xrefs.text: I will punish Bel in Babylon. I will make him spew out what he swallowed. The nations will no longer stream to him; even the wall of Babylon will fall.
Look, here come the riders, horsemen in pairs.” And one answered, saying: “Fallen, fallen is Babylon! All the images of her gods lie shattered on the ground!”

“Announce and declare to the nations; lift up a banner and proclaim it; hold nothing back when you say, ‘Babylon is captured; Bel is put to shame; Marduk is shattered, her images are disgraced, her idols are broken in pieces.’
“Therefore, behold, the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when I will punish her idols, and throughout her land the wounded will groan.
In that day men will cast away to the moles and bats their idols of silver and gold— the idols they made to worship.

verses.text: The gods cower; they crouch together, unable to relieve the burden; but they themselves go into captivity.

xrefs.text: Because you trust in your works and treasures, you too will be captured, and Chemosh will go into exile with his priests and officials.

And the five men who had gone to spy out the land went inside and took the graven image, the ephod, the household idols, and the molten idol, while the priest stood at the entrance of the gate with the six hundred armed men.
There the Philistines abandoned their idols, and David and his men carried them away.
He replied, “You took the gods I had made, and my priest, and went away. What else do I have? How can you say to me, ‘What is the matter with you?’”

I will kindle a fire in the temples of the gods of Egypt, and Nebuchadnezzar will burn those temples and take their gods as captives. So he will wrap himself with the land of Egypt as a shepherd wraps himself in his garment, and he will depart from there unscathed.

verses.text: “Listen to Me, O house of Jacob, all the remnant of the house of Israel, who have been sustained from the womb, carried along since birth.

xrefs.text: and in the wilderness, where the LORD your God carried you, as a man carries his son, all the way by which you traveled until you reached this place.”
Listen to Me, you who know what is right, you people with My law in your hearts: Do not fear the scorn of men; do not be broken by their insults.
“Listen to Me, you who pursue righteousness, you who seek the LORD: Look to the rock from which you were cut, and to the quarry from which you were hewn.
I have leaned on You since birth; You pulled me from my mother’s womb. My praise is always for You.
Yet You brought me forth from the womb; You made me secure at my mother’s breast.

verses.text: Even to your old age, I will be the same, and I will bear you up when you turn gray. I have made you, and I will carry you; I will sustain you and deliver you.

xrefs.text: Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, O God, until I proclaim Your power to the next generation, Your might to all who are to come.
For this God is our God forever and ever; He will be our guide even till death.
In old age they will still bear fruit; healthy and green they will remain,
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.

verses.text: To whom will you liken Me or count Me equal? To whom will you compare Me, that we should be alike?

xrefs.text: To whom will you liken God? To what image will you compare Him?
“To whom will you liken Me, or who is My equal?” asks the Holy One.
For who in the skies can compare with the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?
O Lord, there is none like You among the gods, nor any works like Yours.
Who, existing in the form of God, did not consider equality with God something to be grasped,

verses.text: They pour out their bags of gold and weigh out silver on scales; they hire a goldsmith to fashion it into a god, so they can bow down and worship.

xrefs.text: Therefore, being offspring of God, we should not think that the Divine Being is like gold or silver or stone, an image formed by man’s skill and imagination.
To an idol that a craftsman casts and a metalworker overlays with gold and fits with silver chains?
Every man is senseless and devoid of knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols. For his molten images are a fraud, and there is no breath in them.
As soon as you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipes, and all kinds of music, you must fall down and worship the golden statue that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up.
So Aaron told them, “Take off the gold earrings that are on your wives and sons and daughters, and bring them to me.”

verses.text: They lift it to their shoulder and carry it along; they set it in its place, and there it stands, not budging from that spot. They cry out to it, but it does not answer; it saves no one from his troubles.

xrefs.text: Come, gather together, and draw near, you fugitives from the nations. Ignorant are those who carry idols of wood and pray to a god that cannot save.
Like scarecrows in a cucumber patch, their idols cannot speak. They must be carried because they cannot walk. Do not fear them, for they can do no harm, and neither can they do any good.”
Bel crouches; Nebo cowers. Their idols weigh down beasts and cattle. The images you carry are burdensome, a load to the weary animal.
When the people of Ashdod got up early the next morning, there was Dagon, fallen on his face before the ark of the LORD. So they took Dagon and returned him to his place.
So they cried out to the LORD: “Please, O LORD, do not let us perish on account of this man’s life! Do not charge us with innocent blood! For You, O LORD, have done as You pleased.”

verses.text: Remember this and be brave; take it to heart, you transgressors!

xrefs.text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Consider carefully your ways.
Now this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Consider carefully your ways.
Because he considered and turned from all the transgressions he had committed, he will surely live; he will not die.
You said, ‘I will be queen forever.’ You did not take these things to heart or consider their outcome.
Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.

verses.text: Remember what happened long ago, for I am God, and there is no other; I am God, and there is none like Me.

xrefs.text: Speak up and present your case— yes, let them take counsel together. Who foretold this long ago? Who announced it from ancient times? Was it not I, the LORD? There is no other God but Me, a righteous God and Savior; there is none but Me.
Behold, the former things have happened, and now I declare new things. Before they spring forth I proclaim them to you.”
He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.
To whom will you liken Me or count Me equal? To whom will you compare Me, that we should be alike?
“There is none like the God of Jeshurun, who rides the heavens to your aid, and the clouds in His majesty.

verses.text: I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times what is still to come. I say, ‘My purpose will stand, and all My good pleasure I will accomplish.’

xrefs.text: Many plans are in a man’s heart, but the purpose of the LORD will prevail.
The counsel of the LORD stands forever, the purposes of His heart to all generations.
And He has made known to us the mystery of His will according to His good pleasure, which He purposed in Christ
Even from eternity I am He, and none can deliver out of My hand. When I act, who can reverse it?”

Speak up and present your case— yes, let them take counsel together. Who foretold this long ago? Who announced it from ancient times? Was it not I, the LORD? There is no other God but Me, a righteous God and Savior; there is none but Me.

verses.text: I summon a bird of prey from the east, a man for My purpose from a far-off land. Truly I have spoken, and truly I will bring it to pass. I have planned it, and I will surely do it.

xrefs.text: God is not a man, that He should lie, or a son of man, that He should change His mind. Does He speak and not act? Does He promise and not fulfill?
The LORD of Hosts has sworn: “Surely, as I have planned, so will it be; as I have purposed, so will it stand.
But He is unchangeable, and who can oppose Him? He does what He desires.

Who has aroused one from the east and called him to his feet in righteousness He hands nations over to him and subdues kings before him. He turns them to dust with his sword, to windblown chaff with his bow.
In Him we were also chosen as God’s own, having been predestined according to the plan of Him who works out everything by the counsel of His will,

verses.text: Listen to Me, you stubborn people, far removed from righteousness:

xrefs.text: This is what the LORD says: “What fault did your fathers find in Me that they strayed so far from Me? They followed worthless idols, and became worthless themselves.
“Listen to Me, O house of Jacob, all the remnant of the house of Israel, who have been sustained from the womb, carried along since birth.
But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far away have been brought near through the blood of Christ.
For I knew that you are stubborn; your neck is iron and your forehead is bronze.
The valiant lie plundered; they sleep their last sleep. No men of might could lift a hand.

verses.text: I am bringing My righteousness near; it is not far away, and My salvation will not be delayed. I will grant salvation to Zion and adorn Israel with My splendor.

xrefs.text: Behold, the LORD has proclaimed to the ends of the earth, “Say to Daughter Zion: See, your Savior comes! Look, His reward is with Him, and His recompense goes before Him.”
Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song, and He also has become my salvation.”
My righteousness draws near, My salvation is on the way, and My arms will bring justice to the nations. The islands will look for Me and wait in hope for My arm.

to console the mourners in Zion— to give them a crown of beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, and a garment of praise for a spirit of despair. So they will be called oaks of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that He may be glorified.

Sing for joy, O heavens, for the LORD has done this; shout aloud, O depths of the earth. Break forth in song, O mountains, you forests and all your trees. For the LORD has redeemed Jacob, and revealed His glory in Israel.
